investigation_notes.Description: A Dark Web monitoring feed identified Vitalis Healthcare referenced on an onion site with linked dump directories containing multiple files. The exposed artifacts include a patient database SQL file, an employee payroll spreadsheet, and a central firewall configuration backup, indicating disclosure of sensitive personal, HR, and network infrastructure data. This is classified as High Priority because the presence of patient records and network configurations on a publicized dark web resource creates elevated risk of privacy violations, regulatory impact, and operational compromise and therefore requires escalation for verification and containment.
